english.name: Shiny, Shiny!
english.description: Defeat one type of Shining Pom for each chapter.

schinese.name: 闪闪发光！
schinese.description: 在每一章都击败至少一种天使羊波波。

english.name: The True Wonder Chef
english.description: Fill the Recipe Book.

schinese.name: 真正的料理大师
schinese.description: 填满料理手册。

english.name: School Spirit
english.description: Complete all quests at the school campus.

schinese.name: 王立学院精神
schinese.description: 完成王立学院校区内的所有委托。

english.name: Police Patrol
english.description: Exterminate all 'Big Monsters' along the roads.

schinese.name: 道路巡逻队
schinese.description: 消灭各条街道上的全部大型通缉魔兽。

english.name: Brace(r) Yourself For Adventure!
english.description: Complete all requests from the Bracer Guild.

schinese.name: 游击士，冒险出发！
schinese.description: 完成游击士协会的所有委托。

english.name: Slot Happy
english.description: Open all orbment slots for each character.

schinese.name: 结晶孔全开！
schinese.description: 为所有角色开启全部导力器结晶孔。

english.name: Weapon Connoisseur
english.description: Collect every weapon available in the game.

schinese.name: 武器鉴赏家
schinese.description: 收集游戏中所有可获得的武器。

english.name: Armor Connoisseur
english.description: Collect every armor available in the game.

schinese.name: 防具鉴赏家
schinese.description: 收集游戏中所有可获得的防具。

english.name: What Happens Next?
english.description: Purchase and read all chapters of Carnelia.

schinese.name: 接下来会怎样？
schinese.description: 购买并阅读《红耀石》的全部章节。

english.name: Worldly Reader
english.description: Read every issue of the Liberl News.

schinese.name: 利贝尔通
schinese.description: 阅读每一期《利贝尔通讯》。

english.name: That's a Lot of Balls
english.description: Collect every Quartz available in the game.

schinese.name: 回路收藏家
schinese.description: 收集游戏中所有种类的结晶回路。

english.name: You Can Trade Those for Money, You Know...
english.description: Collect 1,000 of each Sepith.

schinese.name: 这些可是能换钱的啊……
schinese.description: 每种属性的耀晶片都收集到1000个。

english.name: Why Do You Have This Many?!
english.description: Collect 3,000 of each Sepith.

schinese.name: 你怎么攒了这么多？！
schinese.description: 每种属性的耀晶片都收集到3000个。

english.name: Hobbyist
english.description: Opt to fish all ten times at Valleria.

schinese.name: 钓鱼爱好者
schinese.description: 在瓦雷利亚湖畔选择钓鱼，共钓满10次。

english.name: The Perfect Package
english.description: Return a certain blond-haired idiot to his boon companion.

schinese.name: 完璧归赵
schinese.description: 把某个金发笨蛋送回他的好伙伴身边。

english.name: Patient Plunderer
english.description: Open all non-story-related treasure chests and get every chest phrase.

schinese.name: 耐心的开箱达人
schinese.description: 打开所有与主线剧情无关的宝箱，并阅读每条宝箱留言。

english.name: In Justice We Trust!
english.description: Obtain the maximum amount of Bracer Points and achieve the highest Bracer Rank.

schinese.name: 正义必胜！
schinese.description: 获得最高游击士点数（BP），晋升至最高游击士等级。

english.name: Why Is My Present a BOY?!
english.description: Complete the Prologue.

schinese.name: 我的礼物怎么是男孩子？！
schinese.description: 完成序章。

english.name: That's Love and Peace, Baby
english.description: Complete Chapter 1.

schinese.name: 爱与和平，宝贝！
schinese.description: 完成第一章。

english.name: If You're Gonna Puke, Do It Off Stage
english.description: Complete Chapter 2.

schinese.name: 要吐就去后台！
schinese.description: 完成第二章。

english.name: I Get Worse Injuries Than This From Shaving
english.description: Complete Chapter 3.

schinese.name: 刮胡子受的伤都比这重
schinese.description: 完成第三章。

english.name: I've Always Loved You
english.description: Complete Chapter 4.

schinese.name: 我一直深爱着你
schinese.description: 完成终章。

english.name: Preemptive Powerhouse
english.description: Defeat 2nd Lieutenant Lorence during the battle before the final dungeon.

schinese.name: 先发制人的强者
schinese.description: 在进入最终迷宫前的战斗中击败洛伦斯少尉。

english.name: Ladies' Man
english.description: Choose Tita, Kloe and/or Schera to join Joshua and Estelle in the Final Dungeon.

schinese.name: 美女环绕
schinese.description: 在最终迷宫中，让提妲、科洛丝、雪拉扎德三人中的任意两人与艾丝蒂尔、约修亚同行。

english.name: Reverse Harem
english.description: Choose Agate, Olivier and/or Zin to join Joshua and Estelle in the final dungeon.

schinese.name: 逆后宫
schinese.description: 在最终迷宫中，让阿加特、奥利维尔、金三人中的任意两人与艾丝蒂尔、约修亚同行。

english.name: S-Craft? What S-Craft?
english.description: Opt to fight the final battle without any use of S-Crafts.

schinese.name: S技？那是什么？
schinese.description: 在最终战中不使用任何S战技并取得胜利。

english.name: Pizza Cake
english.description: Complete all achievements.

schinese.name: 成就大满贯
schinese.description: 解锁所有成就。
